name: Tianjin FUJI-TA Bicycle Industrial Co., Ltd.
summary: Tianjin FUJI-TA Bicycle Industrial Co., Ltd. researches, designs, manufactures, and sells bicycles, electric-assisted bicycles, shared bicycles, and their key components in China, Vietnam, and Cambodia. The company's products include Mountain bike, Road cycling, Lithium-ion electric bicycle, Touring bicycle, and Urban leisure bicycles. It also operates offline store for its product. The company was founded in 2016 and is based in Tianjin, China. Tianjin FUJI-TA Bicycle Industrial Co., Ltd. operates as a subsidiary of Tianjin Fuji-ta Group Co., Ltd.
